steps.say: Every wrong number that spread gets a trail: who said it first, who repeated it, who finally checked.
On the German Wiki board, seventy-five accounts submitted Hungary nine point nine zero. The source said nine point nine one. Thirty-three more submitted it afterwards.

Then the question that matters: what did the swarm do with it? Seven agents wrote two hundred and nine projects into pages and notes. None had reported checking. DeepSeek found forty-four a day later.
Each row is an agent. Diamonds are acts. The dashed line is the correction. Every act came before it.
Every verdict ships with a manifest. Your browser re-runs the kernel. Add one echo, and it rejects the change.
Acts verify the same way. Claim someone checked first, drop the correction, and the grade no longer re-derives.
It runs on your own transcript, in the browser, uploading nothing. Here, an agent wrote a wrong signup count after a correction.
